sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled is a 27-billion parameter reasoning model built on the Qwen3.5 architecture and fine-tuned using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation from Claude-4.6-Opus interactions. Created by Jackrong, this model excels at structured problem-solving by breaking down complex queries into step-by-step reasoning within strictly formatted <think> tags ...
